esp32.detail: 7 pins wired; Added a 4.7 kΩ pull-up resistor from SCL/SPC to 3V3, as the datasheet requires. Added a 4.7 kΩ pull-up resistor from SDA/SDI/SDO to 3V3, as the datasheet requires. It shares the I2C bus (SDA D21, SCL D22) at address 0x1d. Added the lis2hh12.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the X, Y and Z acceleration set on the sliders: passes
